description: P3 (D-141): 1900 currencies, monetary arrangements and opening valuations of the 1900 world. Each own currency records its standard, the metal of its legal unit and how its value is derived; the loader computes the fine content per unit, the 1900 circulating value in US gold dollars and rusdPerUnit = value x CPI(1990)/CPI(1900). This file supersedes the currency blocks of historical/p2b/countries_1900.json for the 1900 world.
